description_text: Software Engineer, Backend (New Grad) at Northwind Pay. Toronto, ON (Hybrid). Northwind Pay builds payout and reconciliation infrastructure for online marketplaces. What you'll do: build and operate backend services that move money between marketplaces and their sellers; design reliable, idempotent APIs used by internal teams and external partners; own services in production including on-call, observability and incident follow-ups; collaborate with product and risk teams. What we're looking for: BS in Computer Science or equivalent, graduating by mid-2026; proficiency in Go, Java, or Python; experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL; understanding of distributed systems fundamentals; clear written communication. Nice to have: Kafka or other event streaming, Kubernetes and Docker, CI/CD and automated testing, Terraform, payments or fintech experience. You thrive in a fast-paced environment.
